text_block_list.text:
Upon arriving at the shopping mall, I ran 
into North Flight. As we were making small 
talk—

text_block_list.name: Stylish Woman
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*. Why does this feel so 
uninspired? I'm just... getting so tired 
of it.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: That lady from before...

Turning toward the voice, we saw the 
stylish woman we had spotted previously. 
Our eyes met, and out of slight 
awkwardness, we exchanged polite nods.

text_block_list.name: Stylish Woman
text_block_list.text:
Ah... that hat is absolutely adorable. Did 
you pick it out yourself? It has a bright 
palette, but the black accents give it a 
grounded elegance...

text_block_list.name: Stylish Woman
text_block_list.text:
It suits you so well... Oh, I'm so sorry! 
Blurting out out of nowhere like that... I 
mean, speaking to you so suddenly.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! Thank you so much for the 
compliment. Your outfit is wonderful too♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It's refined, yet carries a lovely casual 
touch. Is that thanks to the stripes along 
the sleeves?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It suits you remarkably well. ...Though, a 
moment ago, you mentioned something being 
'uninspired.'

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Could you have been referring to your 
clothes?

text_block_list.name: Stylish Woman
text_block_list.text: Eh...? How did you know?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth, by pure coincidence... 
I've seen you around a few times before.

text_block_list.name: Stylish Woman
text_block_list.text:
I see. Actually, I thought I'd seen the 
two of you somewhere before as well. So it 
wasn't just my imagination, huh?

text_block_list.name: Stylish Woman
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... How embarrassing. Well, since I'm 
already blushing, would you mind hearing 
me out?

—In the past, getting dressed up used to 
be so fun. Wearing clothes I loved lifted 
my spirits and filled me with 
motivation—or so she told us.

text_block_list.name: Stylish Woman
text_block_list.text:
But nowadays... no matter what I wear, it 
feels boring. Even though I keep up with 
trends and feel confident that I style 
brand-name items properly.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Your current outfit is balanced 
and beautifully put together, just like a 
textbook ensemble.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
And yet, you still feel that it's 
'uninspired,' don't you?

text_block_list.name: Stylish Woman
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Well, it's a silly thing to worry 
about. It's just a hobby, not my job or 
anything. ...I just keep remembering how 
much fun it used to be.

text_block_list.name: Stylish Woman
text_block_list.text:
Well, everything was fun back in school, 
anyway! Maybe finding it boring is just a 
part of growing up~? Just kidding. Ahaha.

North Flight's expression remained bright. 
She directed an earnest gaze toward the 
woman, who was smiling in 
self-deprecation.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Miss. Back during your school days... why 
was it fun? What was the reason your 
spirits were lifted?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Was it because they were clothes you 
loved? Or because you were wearing the 
latest trends? ...Surely, it wasn't just 
that.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Besides, this isn't a silly problem at 
all. It's something causing you real 
distress. That's why—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Please try to find it! What you are 
searching for right now. The reason why it 
felt so 'fun' to you.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
If it's you, miss... I'm sure you can find 
it.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It's not... because you're an adult. It's 
just that after growing up, you got 
trapped inside the "mold of correctness."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Wear this like that. Style it this way. 
The exact shape from the catalog—that kind 
of correctness.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
If you feel bored by it, then what you're 
truly seeking isn't there.

...I see. But I feel like I understand 
what North Flight means.
choice_data_list: ...Do you think she can find it?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
She'll be fine. After all, her eyes showed 
that she's still searching.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I really want to cheer her on! So... I 
choose to believe she can find it.

North Flight's eyes sparkled with 
anticipation for that moment to come.
